Thanks again for the call earlier, Alex — appreciated the time. Per our discussion, summary and requested next steps below so your security team has what they asked for.

Key items we covered
- SOC 2 status: Redwood is in final stages of our Type II audit cycle; Type II report expected Q3 2026 (preliminary controls evidence available now).
- Data residency & GDPR/HIPAA: We support regionally isolated deployments (US/EU) and offer HIPAA-compliant private deployments with BAA; we treat PHI as covered when deployed in private mode.
- Incident response & breach notification: Redwood maintains a documented IR plan and escalation playbooks. Typical internal detection -> triage -> notification timelines: confirmation of material breach within 72 hours for GDPR-sensitive cases; state-level notifications depend on impacted data and jurisdiction — we'll provide our standard timelines and examples.
- BCP/DR evidence requests: You asked for proof of DR tests, RTO/RPO targets, and high-level DR runbook excerpts.
- Vendor security questionnaire: We'll fill your standard questionnaire but also can provide an XLSX template for you to tailor.

Next steps (actions and owners)
1) Rachel (me): Share a short security summary (SOC 2 status, IR timelines, BCP highlights) and a vendor questionnaire template by EOD tomorrow — attaching the summary and template now.
2) Alex / Priya (FintechCorp): Please confirm specific evidence items you need from BCP (DR test report, RTO/RPO numbers, signed runbook excerpts) and preferred delivery channel (secure share, SFTP, or portal).
3) Laura (security): We will loop in our Security Ops contact for detailed IR Q&A and provide a point of contact for SIRT engagement.

Attachments included (stubs):
- Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf (SOC 2 status, IR overview, GDPR/HIPAA note)
- Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx (fillable)

If anything above is off, flag it and I'll adjust. Otherwise I'll start the questionnaire fill and Laura will follow up on DR evidence logistics.

Best,
